summary: @ornikar/prismic-components preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs" and ships no advertised functionality — the declared main index.js is missing from the tarball, the description and author fields are empty, and only setup.mjs plus math_init.js are present. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs) using string-array rotation and _0xNNNN hex-identifier obfuscation, with a shuffled constant pool decoded by a rotation function. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern — fetching a second language runtime purely to execute a bundled opaque payload outside Node's evaluation — combined with obfuscation, an empty manifest, and use of the @ornikar/ scope with no legitimate Prismic component code delivered, is a supply-chain attack vehicle rather than a functional package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
